en.image_alt: The fourth in-person Consortium Meeting was held on 22-23 August 2024 in Horw
en.body:
The fourth in-person consortium meeting of EDGE was held on 22 and 23 August 2024 at the University of Lucerne (HSLU), on the campus of Horw. EDGE PhDs and postdocs from all working groups presented their latest work. A social activity and a social dinner were also be organized to strengthen relationships.

Consortium meetings are always a great way to exchange ideas and reflect on progress. The previous in-person consortium meeting was held on 23 August 2023, a day after the biennial conference in Bern.
